verses.text: Ibi ni ivyo Nahumu yavugishijwe vyerekeye Ninewe. Biri mu gitabu, akaba yabironse mu kwerekwa ari i Elikoshi.
Uhoraho ni Imana ipfuha kandi yihora; Uhoraho ni Imana yihora kandi ifise uburake bwinshi. Uhoraho yihora abamugwanya, kandi uburake bwiwe abwamiza ku bansi biwe.
Uhoraho ateba kuraka, ariko ni umunyenkomezi ahambaye; Uhoraho nta ho azoreka guhana uwagiriwe n’icaha. Yigaragariza mu gashururu no mu gihuhusi, kandi ibicu ni nk’umukungugu musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Akankamira ikiyaga kigakama, agakamya inzuzi zose. I Bashani n’i Karumeli harumye, kandi amashurwe y’i Libani arakabiranye.
Imisozi iratigita imbere yiwe, udutumba tugashonga. Isi ihinda agashitsi imbere yiwe, co kimwe n’abayibako bose.
Ni nde yohagarara imbere y’uburake bwiwe, ni nde yokwihanganira uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi? Umujinya wiwe iyo usutswe umeze nk’umuriro; amenagura ibitandara.
Uhoraho ni mwiza, ni ubuhungiro mu gihe c’amagorwa, kandi yitaho abamuhungirako.
Ariko asendanishije nk’umwuzure w’amazi menshi, azorandura Ninewe. Kandi abansi biwe azobakurikirana, gushika no mu mwijima.
Ivyo mutegura vyose vyo kugwanya Uhoraho Azokubita rimwe gusa, abarandure, ntazorinda gukubita irya kabiri.
Abansi biwe bazomera nk’abari mu mahwa y’inzitane, bamere nk’abantu baborewe umuvinyu mwinshi. Bazotongorwa nk’ubwatsi bwumye.
Muri wewe, yewe Ninewe, hariho uwosha abantu afise imigabo mibi k’ Uhoraho , akagira inama mbi abantu.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “N’aho abansi bawe ari benshi kandi bakaba bakomeye, bazorandurwa baherengetere. Namwe Bayuda bantu banje, n’aho nigeze kubababaza, sinzosubira.
Ngiye kuvuna ingogo iri ku bitugu vyanyu, ncagagure n’iminyororo ibaboshe.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho ategetse ku bwawe, yewe Ninewe: “Ntuzosubira kuronka uruvyaro rwitirirwa izina ryawe. Nzorandura ibishushanyo bibajwe n’ibibumbano biri mu ngoro z’imana zanyu. Nzokwimbira imva, kuko uri umunyakibi.”

Ehe ku mpinga z’imisozi, hari ibirenge vy’abazanye inkuru nziza, bazanye inkuru z’amahoro! Gira imisi mikuru yawe, yewe Yuda, ushitse n’ivyo wasezeranye. Nta banyakibi bazosubira kugutera; kuko bazorandurwa baherengetere.
Ehe uwugutera arakwegereje, yewe Ninewe! Rinda inzitiro, rinda amabarabara, kenyera zigume, ambara inkomezi!
Uhoraho agiye kugarukana icubahiro ca Yakobo, nk’icubahiro ca Isirayeli, naho abaranduzi bari bahasahuye, bakahagira nk’umuzabibu wahonye.
Inkinzo z’ingabo ziwe zisize ibara ritukura, n’ingabo zambaye ibitukura. Ivyuma vy’imikogote yiwe birakayangana, ku musi wo kwitegura kwiwe, amacumu akwikiye mu biti vy’amasederi arahungabana.
Imikogote y’intambara irahinda mu mabarabara, inyuragirana ahantu hose. Imeze nk’ibishirira, inyaruka nk’imiravyo.
Umwami w’i Ninewe ahamagaye abakuru b’ingabo ziwe, baza baratsitara mu nzira. Bihuta baja ku nzitiro zaho, bafashe inkinzo zo kwikingira.
Inzugi zija ku ruzi zirabomowe, n’ikirimba c’umwami kirahomvotse.
Itegeko ryasohotse, rivuga ko ab’i Ninewe bajanwa ari inyagano kure. Incoreke zaho ziboroga nk’inuma zikubita ku gikiriza.
I Ninewe hameze nk’itangi y’amazi, abantu baho biruka nk’amazi yayo iyo itobotse. Umwe agasemerera, ati: “Hagarara, hagarara!” Ariko mu bariko barahunga nta n’uwukebuka.
Sahura ifeza! Sahura inzahabu! Ubutunzi bwaho ntibuhera, huzuye ibintu vy’agaciro bidaharurika.
Igisagara kirasahuwe, kirambuwe, kirasenyuwe! Imitima irashonga, amavi acitse intege, imibiri irajugumira, abantu bose barahinduriye mu maso.
Icobo c’intare kiri hehe, ico bagabuririramwo izikiri ntonto, Cari ikibanza intambwe z’ingabo n’ingore zatemberanamwo n’ivyana vyazo ata co zinona.
Intambwe yahigira ivyana vyayo ibikwiye, ikanigira ibikoko ingore yayo, ikuzuza amasenga ivyo yishe, ivyobo vyayo ikavyuzuza ivyo yasahuye.

Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ati: “Nzokugwanya. Nzoturira imikogote yawe icike umunyota, intambwe zawe zikiri ntonto zimarwe n’inkota. Nta munyago nzogusigira kw’isi, n’amajwi y’intumwa zawe ntazosubira kwumvikana.”
Uzobona ibara, yewe wa mugwa wuzuye amaraso, wuzuye ibinyoma, wuzuye ubwambuzi, utigera uburamwo umuvyimba!
Umve urwamo rw’ibimoko, uguhinda kw’amaguru y’imikogote, umuvuduko w’amafarasi, uguhinda kw’imikogote y’intambara!
Ehe uwugwanira kw’ifarasi, inkota zica ibibatsi, n’amacumu ararabagirana! Hari abishwe benshi, ibirundo vy’imivyimba, n’imivyimba myinshi abantu bagenda bayitsitarako.
Ivyo vyose bitewe n’ubusambanyi bwa maraya w’agahebuza, w’ubwiza bukwega, umuhinga mu mareba, yabohesheje amahanga ubusambanyi bwiwe, amoko na yo akayabohesha uburozi bwiwe.
“Nzokugwanya,” ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze. “Nzoduza impuzu zawe ndazigupfuke mu maso. Nzogaragariza amahanga ubwambure bwawe, isi yose ndayereke ibiteye isoni vyawe.
Nzokurundako ibiteye isoni, nerekane ko ukengeretse, ntume uba agatwengo.
Abazokubona bose bazoguhunga, bavuge bati: ‘Ninewe habaye umusaka; ni nde yoharirira?’ ”
Mbega uruta igisagara ca Tebesi, cari ku nkengera y’uruzi Nili, gikikujwe n’amazi? Urwo ruzi ni rwo rwari rugikingiye, kandi amazi yari akibereye nk’igihome kigikingira.
Etiyopiya na Egiputa vyari inkomezi zaco zitagira aho ziherera; Puti na Libiya vyari mu vyifatanije na co.

Ariko caratewe kirafatwa, abantu baco batwarwa mu kinyago. Inzoya zaco ziciwe mu mayirabiri zihondagujwe amabuye. Abubahwa baco batwawe nk’abaja hakoreshejwe ubupfindo. Abatware baho baboheshejwe iminyororo.
Na wewe Ninewe uzoborerwa ku bw’umubabaro; urondere ingene wokwinyegeza, uhunge abansi bawe.
Ibihome vyawe bimeze nk’ibiti vy’imisukoni, iyo yeze ivyamwa vyayo vya mbere; barayinyiganyiza, insukoni zayo zigahungurukira mu kanwa k’uwuzirya.
Ehe raba ingabo zawe zose; zisigaye zifise intege nke nk’abagore! Amarembo yawe aratamanzuye, yugururiwe abansi bawe; umuriro na wo wacagaguye ibihindizo vyayo.
Vomera mu bigega vy’amazi, amazi akwiye kuko ugiye guterwa, ukomeze ibihome vyawe! Katura ibumba, ukanyage ubudongo, ufate iforoma yo gufyatura amatafari yo kuzibira ibihengeri.
Ariko na ho nyene, umuriro uzogutongora, inkota izokurigata, nk’uko inzige zirigita ivyatsi. Nta wuzorokoka, naho mwogwira mukangana n’inzige.
Wagwijije abadandaza bangana n’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, ariko bameze nk’inzige zitongora ibiterwa vyo mu gihugu, zaheza zikagorora amababa zikigurukira.
Abarinzi bawe bangana n’inzige, n’abatware bawe bangana n’inzige zirundana ku nzitiro iyo hakanye, ariko akazuba katse zikigurukira, kandi nta n’uwumenya irengero ryazo.
Yewe mwami wa Ashuri, abungere barasinziriye kandi ntibazokwikangura; abahambaye bararuhutse ubwa nyuma. Ubwoko bwawe bushwiragiriye mu misozi, kandi nta wo kubegeranya azoboneka.
Nta kintu coshobora kugukiza, kuko uruguma rwawe ntirushobora gukira. Abumvise ivyakubayeko bose bakoma amashi, bakwitamba ku muvyimba. Kuko ukugira nabi kwawe ata we kutasesereje.
